#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Builds research/jv_nagao_hilbert_20261112/validation/validator-report.json from the validator's own
recompute (recompute.py -> full.json), certificate check (certcheck.py) and local replay (vrun/)."""
import json, hashlib, os, glob, math, sys

SP = '/tmp/claude-0/-home-user/5d26ea47-4c79-5b59-bd9c-e47e6411a571/scratchpad'
ROOT = '/home/user/crypto'
ST = ROOT + '/research/jv_nagao_hilbert_20261112'
VA = ST + '/validation'
OUT = VA + '/validator-report.json'

def sha(p):
    h = hashlib.sha256()
    with open(p, 'rb') as f:
        h.update(f.read())
    return h.hexdigest()

def rel(p):
    return os.path.relpath(p, VA)

def load(p):
    with open(p) as f:
        return json.load(f)

full = load(SP + '/vcheck/full.json')
cert = load(SP + '/vcheck/cert_out.json')
local = load(SP + '/vcheck/local_replay.json')
extra = load(SP + '/vcheck/extra.json')

# ---------------- raw data ----------------
raw = []
files = sorted(glob.glob(ST + '/results/*.json')) + sorted(glob.glob(VA + '/replay/*.json')) \
    + sorted(glob.glob(VA + '/replay_1thread/*.json')) + sorted(glob.glob(VA + '/rho_fresh_run0-13/rhostrong_*.json')) \
    + sorted(glob.glob(VA + '/rho_fresh_run14-27/rhostrong_*.json')) \
    + sorted(glob.glob(ROOT + '/research/jv_cover_negrho_rescore_20261101/results/inputs/old_rhostrong/rhostrong_p1[346]*.json')) \
    + sorted(glob.glob(ROOT + '/research/jv_cover_negrho_rescore_20261101/results/new/rhostrong_p*.json')) \
    + sorted(glob.glob(ROOT + '/research/jv_cover_fbline_20261102/results/line_p*.json')) \
    + [ST + '/rescore/fit.json', VA + '/rescore_fresh_run0-13/fit.json', VA + '/rescore_fresh_run14-27/fit.json',
       VA + '/rescore_combined_run0-27/fit.json', VA + '/VALIDATION.json', VA + '/replay-certificate.json',
       ST + '/run.sh', VA + '/pod_run.sh', VA + '/pod_run2.sh', ST + '/results/SOURCE_COMMIT', ST + '/results/BINARY.sha256']
seen = set()
for f in files:
    if f in seen:
        continue
    seen.add(f)
    raw.append({'path': rel(f), 'sha256': sha(f)})

# ---------------- headline ----------------
H = []
def add(name, claimed, recomputed, tol=1e-9, src=None):
    d = {'name': name, 'claimed': claimed, 'recomputed': recomputed, 'rel_tol': tol}
    if src:
        d['claimed_from'] = src
    H.append(d)

sets = [('pooled_0-13', ST + '/rescore/fit.json', '../rescore/fit.json (study, = rescore_fresh_run0-13/fit.json)'),
        ('fresh_14-27', VA + '/rescore_fresh_run14-27/fit.json', 'rescore_fresh_run14-27/fit.json'),
        ('combined_0-27', VA + '/rescore_combined_run0-27/fit.json', 'rescore_combined_run0-27/fit.json')]
W = ['0', '0.1', '1']
for nm, fp, src in sets:
    f = load(fp)
    for c in f['band_5a']:
        u = 'U1' if c['unit'].startswith('U1') else 'U2'
        for i, w in enumerate(W):
            add('%s|%s|p%d|w=%s|S/rho' % (nm, u, c['p'], w), c['ratio'][i], full['ratios'][nm]['%s_w%s_p%d' % (u, w, c['p'])]['ratio'], src=src)
    for u, key in [('U1', 'U1 group additions|(b) pooled new primes'), ('U2', 'U2 textbook F_p mults|(b) pooled new primes')]:
        add('%s|%s|p* model (b)' % (nm, u), f['p_star'][key]['p_star'], full['ratios'][nm]['pstar_' + u], src=src)
    pc = f['positive_control']['b']
    add('%s|rho steps/sqrt(l) mean (b)' % nm, pc['mean'], full['ratios'][nm]['steps_over_sqrtl'], src=src)
    add('%s|rho positive-control z (b)' % nm, pc['z'], full['ratios'][nm]['z'], tol=1e-6, src=src)
V = load(VA + '/VALIDATION.json')
for w in W:
    for side in ['ic', 'rho']:
        add('VALIDATION.json gae_band U2 p1601 w=%s %s' % (w, side), V['rho_reference']['gae_band'][w][side],
            full['ratios']['pooled_0-13']['U2_w%s_p1601' % w][side], src='VALIDATION.json')
P = load(ST + '/results/paired.json')
for r in P:
    add('stage1 S_B/S_A p%d s%d' % (r['p'], r['seed']), r['S_ratio'], full['stage1']['p%d_s%d' % (r['p'], r['seed'])]['SB_SA'], src='../results/paired.json')
RC = load(VA + '/replay-certificate.json')
for r in RC['runs']:
    L = r['run']
    add('replay total_muls %s' % L, r['total_muls'], full['cover_replay'][L]['total_muls'], src='replay-certificate.json')
    add('replay S %s (= total_muls/(c_add_e sqrt l))' % L, r['s'], full['cover_replay'][L]['s_recomputed'], src='replay-certificate.json')
add('single-thread hilbert_check_muls p1301 s1', 8875006425, full['cover_replay_1thread']['hcheck_1t'], src='RESULT.md / replay-certificate.json (8.875e9)')

# ---------------- intervals (Monte Carlo, own stream) ----------------
iv = []
for nm, fp, src in sets:
    f = load(fp)
    for c in f['band_5a']:
        u = 'U1' if c['unit'].startswith('U1') else 'U2'
        for i, w in enumerate(W):
            mine = full['boot'][nm]['%s_w%s_p%d' % (u, w, c['p'])]
            iv.append({'cell': '%s|%s|p%d|w=%s' % (nm, u, c['p'], w), 'tool_ci95': c['ci'][i], 'tool_verdict': c['verdicts'][i],
                       'validator_ci95': [round(mine[0], 6), round(mine[1], 6)], 'validator_verdict': mine[2],
                       'max_abs_end_diff': round(max(abs(c['ci'][i][0] - mine[0]), abs(c['ci'][i][1] - mine[1])), 6),
                       'same_verdict': c['verdicts'][i] == mine[2]})

rep = json.load(open(SP + '/vcheck/report_body.json'))
rep['raw_data'] = raw
rep['headline'] = H
rep['intervals'] = {'note': 'validator bootstrap: 20000 resamples, frozen design of research/jv_cover_negrho_rescore_20261101/PROTOCOL.md (seeds with replacement per prime; reference runs with replacement within each of the 9 instances; one reference resample shared by the three primes and all w), numpy PCG64 seed 20261112, not the tool\'s splitmix64 stream: agreement is within Monte Carlo error only',
                    'cells': iv, 'all_verdicts_agree': all(x['same_verdict'] for x in iv),
                    'max_abs_end_diff': max(x['max_abs_end_diff'] for x in iv)}
rep['homogeneity'] = full['homogeneity']
rep['certificate_check'] = cert
rep['local_replay'] = local
rep['extra'] = extra
src = {}
for nmf in ['recompute.py', 'certcheck.py', 'build_report.py']:
    p = SP + '/vcheck/' + nmf
    src[nmf] = {'sha256': sha(p), 'text': open(p).read()}
rep['checker']['source_embedded'] = src
bad = [h for h in H if abs(h['claimed'] - h['recomputed']) > h['rel_tol'] * max(abs(h['claimed']), abs(h['recomputed']), 1e-300)]
rep['headline_summary'] = {'n': len(H), 'n_disagree': len(bad), 'disagree': [b['name'] for b in bad]}
with open(OUT, 'w') as f:
    json.dump(rep, f, indent=1)
    f.write('\n')
print('wrote', OUT, 'headline', len(H), 'disagree', len(bad), 'raw', len(raw), 'sha256', sha(OUT))

But the cover arm names work it does not emit (F_p additions, F4 pair selection, matrix assembly, memory traffic; f4_native_ops is a lower bound), so under 5a it is a lower bound that cannot be ranked; the fbline red team recorded the same failure for this arm. Robustness (derived): the U2 'below' at w = 0.1 and 1 survives only while unemitted cover native work is below 0.46-0.51x of f4_native_ops at p = 1451 and 0.76-0.88x at p = 1601 (extra.cells.cover_native_factor_to_reach_1). If F_p additions were priced as native operations on both arms (MODEL: cover additions approximated by f4_muls), U2 at w = 0.1 and 1 becomes 1.22-1.24 at p = 1451 and 1.02-1.03 at p = 1601 (above). Not listed in the band either: the line search's fb_line.lookups and fb_line.adds (pricing the lookups moves U2 by < 0.005). The U2 ratio at w = 0 (counted F_p multiplications only, additions excluded on both arms) does not depend on this.
